trailhead.label: Place du Cernix, Cohennoz, one of the two starts the board gives

cautions: The whole walk is on a quiet communal road that cars still use: keep your dog on a lead and to the side.
Hay meadows beside the road are farmed: keep your dog out of them.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Bel’Avoine road, Le Cernix to Paravy: Strada di Bel’Avoine, da Le Cernix a Paravy
textIt.Place du Cernix, Cohennoz, one of the tw: Place du Cernix, Cohennoz, una delle due partenze indicate dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.The whole walk is on a quiet communal ro: Tutta la passeggiata è su una tranquilla strada comunale percorsa comunque dalle auto: tieni il cane al guinzaglio e sul bordo.
textIt.Hay meadows beside the road are farmed:: I prati da fieno lungo la strada sono coltivati: tieni il cane fuori.
